g.title: EduSphere
g.text: EduSphere - DATABASE DIAGRAM | 44 TABLES | 88 FOREIGN KEYS
PK = primary key FK = foreign key NULL: Y = allowed, - = not allowed
Source: SQLQuery1.sql | Diagram of the target schema; no database changes
